name: Job Board (sample)
description: A stand-in job board: reads the postings bundled with it, never the network, and reports the ones that match.

keywords.description: A posting matches when its title holds one of these words. Empty matches every posting.

sources.description: The boards this member may read. Empty reads none.

publishes.summary: A posting matched the keywords for the first time. Once per new posting.

fields.name: id
fields.summary: The posting's id, and its document id in the tracker's jobs collection.
